verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions face deduplication, matching against previously seen biometrics, or detecting a reused document under a different name. The closest item (aiprise-docs-15) links sessions and devices across signups, which is device-level fraud linking. That is an adjacent capability, not the duplicate face/document detection this story asks for.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, the platform detects repeat and duplicate identities across verifications — the same face or document resurfacing under different names is flagged automatically
